description: List the fields of ONE object as [{ key, name, type, required }]. Fetches GET /applications/{app_id} and returns the fields of the object whose key === objectKey (e.g. "object_1"). app_id defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

appId.description: Optional Knack Application ID; defaults to the configured KNACK_APPLICATION_ID.

name: knack_list_fields
title: List fields for an object
